title: Epic Mega Jam 2026
author: Emergency_Mastodon56
selftext:
Man, this weekend was a haul. I don’t normally leverage ai in the actual making of a game. I use it to brainstorm, help me figure out which blueprint nodes to use, and shore up the educational aspects that my degree program (Game Design at Full Sail) missed.

This was the first project I’ve worked on where I truly played the role of design director, and the AI worked as the development team.l, and only because it was encouraged by Epic. 

I have to say, I’m impressed more than I thought I would be. I’ve been working on a space game in the side for almost two years now, and am nowhere near to finishing, mainly because the scope is admittedly huge. 

Watching the ai tromp building systems that took me days, weeks, or months to get working was mind boggling.

Anyway, here is my submission, for better or for worse. I’m glad I got to participate in an environment that was not biased from the outset. https://wkinrade.itch.io/any-port-in-a-storm 

Every bit of the workflow is transparent and available on the itch page :)

comments.author: samcripp
comments.body: You should add a video on your itch io page! Good job homie!
